notes_for_editor: Three listings agree on 1931, 1972 and the agency name; brief event '1972 destroyed' matches. No source read describes the remains or public access. A YouTube page titled 'Goblin Knob at Priest Lake' returned no text, so it is not used. The source spells the second staff name 'Lawerence'; check the spelling before publishing. The Priest River Community Foundation page was searched for mentions of this lookout and has none, so the story does not link the 1972 loss or the 1931 build to the 1931 Freeman Lake fire. Photo credits to the Fire Lookout Museum appear without a license, so no photos are added. Two WebSearch calls; five distinct pages read.
